name: Drop
description: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, one creature directly underneath the creature. Hit: 3 (1d6) piercing damage per 10 feet fallen, up to 21 (6d6). Miss: The creature takes half the normal falling damage for the distance fallen.
